goal: Prevent invalid RPC requests from occupying every worker thread and blocking legitimate users
reviewability: Open design trade-offs around password guessing invite review input
agreement: Strong support because closing the easy DoS vector outweighs slower brute-forcing (willcl-ark)
Author is exploring alternatives to mitigate increased password guess rates (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because it stops clients with RPC network access from easily exhausting HTTP worker threads
Severity is moderate since attackers must already have permission to reach the RPC port
